boundary_findings: Canonical binary and typed packet invariants are input conditions; final runtime/correctness budgets are not caller premises.
accepted=true is a syntactic completion flag and does not imply canonicality or a positive denominator for arbitrary malformed data.
Generic StateLift rho and CPS caller Delta are not automatically finite; actual closed program instantiations have separate finite counts.
Terminal observer equalities require the actual operational run/eval theorem to imply executed output.
Generic CPS call results end at the caller return and do not bound arbitrary caller continuation.
Binary-input fifths time is O(q log q) in numeric precision, not polynomial in binary input width alone.
These two fixed components are not a complete serialized provider/compiler machine or single-tape time theorem.
